panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of Nalanda’s great gate at dawn
panels.action: Nalanda Gate Scholar stands poised at the massive carved gateway of Nalanda, robes stirring in the morning breeze as small figures of hopeful students approach along a dusty road lined with stupas.

dialogue.text: At Nalanda’s stone gate, scholars say questions were sharper than swords—only those who could answer entered the hardest classroom of the early medieval world.

i18n.hi: नालंदा के पत्थर के फाटक पर विद्वान कहते थे, सवाल तलवार से तेज थे—जवाब वाले ही दुनिया की सबसे कठिन कक्षा में घुसते थे।

panels.action: From high above, the vast monastic university of Nalanda spreads out: red-brick monasteries, lofty temples, ponds gleaming in the sun, colonnaded lecture halls, and long cloister corridors humming with tiny robed figures.

dialogue.text: Between the 7th and 11th centuries, Nalanda grew into a great monastic university of eastern India, where thousands studied Buddhist philosophy, grammar, logic, medicine and astronomy.

i18n.hi: सातवीं से ग्यारहवीं सदी तक नालंदा पूरब भारत का बड़ा विहार-विश्वविद्यालय बना, जहाँ हजारों लोग बौद्ध दर्शन, व्याकरण, तर्क, चिकित्सा और ज्योतिष पढ़ते थे।

panels.shot: medium shot inside a Nalanda lecture hall
panels.action: Nalanda Gate Scholar, now seated among other senior monks in a pillared hall, listens as a teacher expounds doctrine to rows of attentive students, palm-leaf manuscripts stacked nearby and oil lamps burning softly.

dialogue.text: Xuanzang, the Chinese monk who lived at Nalanda in the 7th century, wrote of its famous teachers, intricate curricula and hours of relentless study and discussion.

i18n.hi: चीनी भिक्षु श्वेनज़ांग, जो सातवीं सदी में नालंदा में रहे, यहाँ के मशहूर आचार्य, पेचीदा पाठ्यक्रम और न थमने वाली पढ़ाई-बहस के बारे में लिखते हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in on a carved gateway arch
panels.action: The camera moves toward a high stone gateway adorned with worn but elegant carvings of lotus medallions and seated Buddhas, with a shadowed archway suggesting an inner world beyond.

dialogue.text: Later Tibetan and Sanskrit traditions remember another feature: dvarapanditas—the gate scholars—who questioned newcomers before they could enter the monastery’s inner world.

i18n.hi: बाद की तिब्बती और संस्कृत परंपराएँ एक और बात याद करती हैं: द्वार-पंडित—फाटक के विद्वान—जो नवागंतुकों से सवाल कर के ही उन्हें विहार के भीतर जाने देते थे।

panels.shot: medium shot of Nalanda Gate Scholar at threshold
panels.action: Nalanda Gate Scholar stands calm at the threshold, one hand resting on the stone jamb, eyes alert as a young aspirant in simple robes bows beyond the gate, clutching a small bundle of manuscripts.

dialogue.text: The legend says nine of ten were turned away. The records do not give numbers. They do show a culture where debate and questions guarded what lay inside.

i18n.hi: कथा कहती है, दस में से नौ लौटाए जाते थे। लेखों में संख्या नहीं है, पर वे दिखाते हैं कि यहाँ सवाल और बहस ही भीतर की रक्षा-दीवार थे।

panels.shot: close-up on Nalanda Gate Scholar’s face
panels.action: Nalanda Gate Scholar’s weathered face fills the frame, eyes sharp yet composed, lips slightly parted as if about to speak, the worn bricks of the gate blurred behind him.

dialogue.text: These gate scholars are not described in Xuanzang’s own book, yet later memory fits Nalanda’s known habit: to test ideas publicly before they were welcomed into its cloisters.

i18n.hi: इन द्वार-पंडितों का ज़िक्र श्वेनज़ांग की किताब में नहीं, पर बाद की याद नालंदा की आदत से मेल खाती है: विचारों को अंदर लेने से पहले खुले में कस कर परखना।

panels.action: Nalanda Gate Scholar faces a nervous young student standing outside the gate, their bare feet on the dust, distant monastery towers rising beyond, a faint line of other aspirants waiting farther down the road.

dialogue.speaker: nalanda_gate_scholars
dialogue.text: You seek Nalanda. First, tell me: where does a question begin?

i18n.hi: तुम नालंदा ढूंढ रहे हो। पहले बताओ, सवाल जन्म कहाँ लेता है?

panels.shot: low-angle wide of gate area with small crowd
panels.action: Several aspirants stand or sit under a tree near the gate, some reciting softly, others watching as Nalanda Gate Scholar engages a candidate, the high brick walls enclosing the monastery behind.

dialogue.text: No written exam halls stood here. Instead, the tradition speaks of verbal fencing at the threshold—probing a student’s grasp of logic, doctrine and grammar before they stepped inside.

i18n.hi: यहाँ लिखित परीक्षा-हॉल नहीं थे। परंपरा चौखट पर जुबानी मुकाबले की बात करती है—अंदर जाने से पहले छात्र की तर्क, मत और व्याकरण की पकड़ टटोलने की।

panels.action: Inside a large brick hall, Nalanda Gate Scholar now joins other monks seated in rows, as two debaters stand at the center, hands gesturing, while listeners lean in, palm leaves open on their laps.

dialogue.text: Xuanzang describes daily debates where rival schools were studied and challenged. Skill in discussion was not decoration—it was a gate into the community of learning.

i18n.hi: श्वेनज़ांग रोज़ की बहसों का ज़िक्र करते हैं, जहाँ विरोधी मतों को पढ़ा और चुनौती दी जाती थी। चर्चा की कुशलता सजावट नहीं—सीधा प्रवेश-द्वार थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of Nalanda Gate Scholar among fellow monks
panels.action: Nalanda Gate Scholar confers quietly with two senior monks in a cloister, the long corridor behind them opening onto small cells with mats, books and simple bowls.

dialogue.text: Modern scholars caution against grand claims about admission statistics. Yet they agree: Nalanda’s fame rested on rigorous peer selection and the constant testing of arguments.

i18n.hi: आज के इतिहासकार दाखिले की गिनतियों पर बड़े दावे से बचाते हैं। पर एक बात मानते हैं: नालंदा की शोहरत कड़ी चयन-प्रक्रिया और दलीलों की लगातार परीक्षा पर टिकी थी।

panels.action: A neat stack of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with string lies on a stone ledge, sunlight catching the incised script; Nalanda Gate Scholar’s hand hovers above one set, pausing thoughtfully.

dialogue.text: Students here learned Buddhist philosophy alongside grammar, logic, medicine and astronomy, often through commentaries on earlier masters—and through sharp questions from peers.

i18n.hi: यहाँ विद्यार्थी बौद्ध दर्शन के साथ व्याकरण, तर्क, चिकित्सा और ज्योतिष पढ़ते थे—अक्सर पुराने आचार्यों की व्याख्याओं से, और साथियों के तीखे सवालों से।

panels.shot: wide shot of cloister with different students
panels.action: A mixed group of monks from different regions—distinguished by subtle differences in robes and features—walk and talk in Nalanda’s cloister, while Nalanda Gate Scholar watches from the side, arms folded.

dialogue.text: Access was shaped by monastic networks, patronage and travel. Not every caste or region came freely. But those who did met a world where debate itself was a common language.

i18n.hi: यहाँ तक पहुँच मठों के जाल, संरक्षकों और यात्राओं से तय होती थी। हर जाति या इलाका यूँ ही नहीं आ पाता था। पर जो आते, उन्हें बहस से बनी एक नई भाषा मिलती थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of gate at dusk
panels.action: At dusk, the Nalanda gate glows in fading light; Nalanda Gate Scholar speaks with a dejected aspirant turning away down the road, while another hopeful figure waits quietly in the shadows.

dialogue.speaker: nalanda_gate_scholars
dialogue.text: Return when your doubt is sharper than your answer. Then we will talk.

i18n.hi: जब तुम्हारा संदेह तुम्हारे जवाब से ज़्यादा तेज हो जाए, तब लौटना। फिर बात होगी।

panels.shot: interior night shot of study cell
panels.action: In a small monk’s cell lit by a single oil lamp, Nalanda Gate Scholar sits cross-legged, eyes closed in reflection, manuscripts beside him, the muffled murmur of distant debates seeping in.

dialogue.text: The gate scholars of memory are less an office than a symbol: elders at the edge of community, guarding it not with walls, but with questions.

i18n.hi: यादों के ये द्वार-पंडित कोई पद नहीं, एक निशानी हैं: सीमा पर बैठे बुज़ुर्ग, जो दीवारों से नहीं, सवालों से समुदाय की रखवाली करते हैं।

panels.shot: wide shot of Nalanda ruins fading into imagined past
panels.action: Modern ruins of Nalanda’s brick structures lie quiet under an open sky; in a ghosted overlay, Nalanda Gate Scholar and lines of students move through the same spaces as if from another age.

dialogue.text: The physical Nalanda fell centuries ago, but its stories of gates and questions travel across Tibet, China and India, reshaped in each retelling.

i18n.hi: सच्चा नालंदा तो सदियों पहले ढह गया, पर उसके फाटक और सवालों की कहानियाँ तिब्बत, चीन और भारत में घूमते-घूमते हर बार नया रूप लेती हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in from gate stones to a modern doorway
panels.action: The camera glides along weathered Nalanda gate stones before the image blends into a simple modern doorway, echoing the shape of the ancient arch, with Nalanda Gate Scholar’s figure lingering in memory.

dialogue.text: Seen through the record and its cautions, Nalanda’s gate scholars remind us: a question can be a doorway—and the hardest path in learning begins before we step inside.

i18n.hi: लेखों और उनकी चेतावनियों के बीच से झाँकते ये द्वार-पंडित याद दिलाते हैं: सवाल भी चौखट होता है—और सीखने की सबसे कठिन राह अंदर कदम रखने से पहले शुरू हो जाती है।
